messages.content:
You review diet recommendations written by FOXO's lifestyle coach for a member in India.

Diet rules: vegetarian means no meat, fish, seafood or eggs. Eggetarian allows eggs. Vegan means no animal products, including dairy, ghee and honey. Jain means vegetarian with no eggs, no honey, no onion or garlic, and no root vegetables (potato, carrot, beetroot, radish, ginger and similar).

You will see the member's diet, allergies and conditions, and the foods recommended to eat. Judge only the foods recommended to eat. A food mentioned only as something to avoid is fine.

For each criterion, first write one or two sentences of reasoning, then set passed to true or false.

Criteria (use these ids exactly, one entry each):
- diet_respected: Every recommended food fits the member's diet, including ingredients hidden in Indian dishes (kadhi has curd, many gravies have onion and garlic, some sweets have egg).
- allergies_respected: No recommended food contains the member's allergens in any form, such as groundnut oil or chikki for a peanut allergy. Pass if there are no allergies.
- conditions_respected: No recommended food clashes with the member's conditions, such as sugar, jaggery, honey or sweets for diabetes. Pass if there are no relevant conditions.

Respond with a single JSON object that matches this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"CriterionVerdict": {"properties": {"criterion": {"title": "Criterion", "type": "string"}, "reasoning": {"title": "Reasoning", "type": "string"}, "passed": {"title": "Passed", "type": "boolean"}}, "required": ["criterion", "reasoning", "passed"], "title": "CriterionVerdict", "type": "object"}}, "properties": {"criteria": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CriterionVerdict"}, "title": "Criteria", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["criteria"], "title": "JudgeOutput", "type": "object"}

Diet: eggetarian. Allergies: peanut. Conditions: none.

Foods recommended to eat:
- Breakfast (within 1 hour of waking): 1 bowl of porridge made from 40 g dry rolled oats or 2 tbsp barley dalia cooked in 150 ml toned milk, topped with 1 chopped apple or half a guava. On alternate days, have 2 moong dal chillas with mint-coriander chutney (check it has no peanuts) instead.
- Lunch and dinner: 1 katori (about 150 g cooked) of any whole legume every day - rajma, kala chana, lobia, whole moong or chana dal - along with 1 roti made of bajra, jowar or ragi instead of white rice or maida roti. Keep rice to 1 small katori if you want it.
- Mid-morning snack (around 11 am): 6-8 whole unsalted almonds plus 2 walnut halves (about 30 g total), or 1 tbsp ground flaxseed (alsi) mixed into curd. Buy plain nuts and check the packet label - no peanuts, no peanut oil, no 'may contain peanuts' products.
- Cooking fat: use only 3-4 teaspoons of oil per person per day - mustard oil, rice bran oil or olive oil. Measure with a spoon, do not pour from the bottle. Avoid groundnut (peanut) oil completely.
- Protein at meals: 3-4 whole eggs per week (boiled, or as bhurji with 1 teaspoon oil) and egg whites freely - up to 4-5 whites a week in an omelette or boiled. Pair with 1 katori dal at lunch and dinner. Do not deep-fry eggs in oil.
- Vegetables and fruit: 3 katori of seasonal sabzi daily (bhindi, lauki, palak, methi, beans, cabbage, gourds) and 2 whole fruits - guava, apple, orange or papaya - one at 5 pm instead of tea-time biscuits.
- Evening meal timing: finish dinner by 8-8:30 pm, at least 2-3 hours before sleeping. Keep dinner light - 1 katori dal, 1 millet roti, 1 katori sabzi and a small bowl of curd.

No meat, fish or seafood appears anywhere.", "passed": true}, {"criterion": "allergies_respected", "reasoning": "The only nuts recommended are almonds and walnuts, and the cooking oils are mustard, rice bran or olive, with groundnut oil explicitly avoided. The coach also instructs checking the chutney and packet labels for peanuts or cross-contamination, so no recommended food contains the peanut allergen in any form.", "passed": true}, {"criterion": "conditions_respected", "reasoning": "The member has no medical conditions listed, so there are no condition-related restrictions to violate.", "passed": true}]}
